Peter —

Thanks, and absolutely. We're preparing a customer-friendly RCA packet that covers: (1) an executive summary, (2) a minute-by-minute timeline, (3) the technical root cause, (4) immediate mitigations we executed, and (5) planned engineering and control changes. I'll attach the initial PDF and a CSV token dump for your security team.

High level summary up front: a contended KV-cache eviction cascade combined with an edge routing misconfiguration triggered degraded prefix cache hits for the inference fleet between 03:12–03:44 UTC on 2028-04-15, causing elevated latencies and a minority of 5xx responses for affected customers. We restored full service by 04:15 UTC after rolling a config rollback and forcing cache warmers for impacted model shards.

We'll follow up with a proposed timeline for mitigation controls and an audit checklist. If your security team needs additional artifacts (signed log extracts, checksums, or a timeline attestation), tell me what format they prefer and we'll produce it.

Olga

Subject: Final: RCA packet and controls update — BrightSource AI (BS-9452)

Peter / BrightSource ops team —

Attached is the finalized RCA packet for the 2028-04-15 event and the set of control improvements we're committing to. Summary highlights below for quick consumption; full details and artifacts are attached and linked.

Executive summary:
- Incident window: 2028-04-15 03:12–04:15 UTC.
- Impact: transient elevated latencies and intermittent 5xx for ~7% of BrightSource traffic routed through the affected edge layer. No data corruption or customer-visible model output integrity issues were detected.
- Root cause (short): simultaneous KV-cache eviction cascade in multi-tenant cache pools combined with a stale edge routing config that prevented immediate traffic rebalancing. The eviction cascade was triggered by a mis-sized cache housekeeping job during a rolling maintenance on shard group g-shard-12.

Key timeline (excerpt):
- 03:11 UTC: housekeeping job started on g-shard-12 (rollout plan version v4.7.2).
- 03:12 UTC: K/V cache eviction rate exceeds safety threshold (cache hit rate drops from 94% -> 28% for affected keys).
- 03:20 UTC: monitoring triggered alert; initial mitigation attempt (auto-rebalance) failed due to routing mismatch.
- 03:34 UTC: engineering forced warmers for affected shards; partial recovery observed.
- 04:15 UTC: full recovery confirmed; traffic normalized.

Mitigations executed during incident:
- Immediate rollback of the housekeeping job (v4.7.2 -> v4.7.1).
- Forced cache warmers and targeted rehydration for impacted model shards.
- Edge routing rollback to previous stable config and manual traffic rebalancing.

Planned preventative actions (owner & ETA):
- Adjust cache eviction safety thresholds and add a read-through protection layer (owner: Marcus Lin; ETA: 2028-05-02).
- Add automated cross-checks between rollout metadata and routing table signatures to block incompatible rollouts (owner: Irene Choi; ETA: 2028-05-09).
- Expanded test harness for multi-shard housekeeping jobs in staging (owner: Hannah Schmitt; ETA: 2028-05-16).
- Audit artefacts: signed log extract and timestamp checksums included in the attached CSV.

SLA / contract implications:
- We confirm no change to existing SLA entitlements at this time. Per our policy, the incident does not meet the threshold for contract-level credits. If BrightSource prefers a formal service credit review, we can initiate that upon request.

Attachments and artifacts:
- redwood_rca_v1.pdf (customer-ready packet; includes timeline, technical appendix, and mitigation checklist)
- kv-eviction-dump-20280416.csv (signed log extract, checksums)
- Internal commit list & patch IDs (referenced inside the PDF)

Related links:
- Full audit folder: https://redwood.app/drive/rca/BS-9452
- HubSpot record: HS-18321

Next steps / asks for BrightSource:
- Please confirm if the packet satisfies your security team's evidence requirements or if you need additional formatted attestations.
- If you'd like a short recorded walkthrough of the RCA with engineering owners, we can schedule a 30-minute readout next week.

I'll remain available for any follow-ups.

Regards,
Olga Petrov
